name: TallyDex Dev
subtitle: Development releases of the native Pokémon TCG collection tracker.
description: Install and update TallyDex development builds through FlareStore, AltStore, SideStore, and other compatible sideloading apps.

apps.name: TallyDex
apps.subtitle: Track Pokémon TCG sets and your collection.
apps.localizedDescription: A native, local-first iPhone app for browsing Pokémon TCG series and sets and building a personal collection.

versions.localizedDescription: Caches all catalog artwork for faster cold launches, adds selective cache controls and copyright attribution, uses the TallyDex mark for missing artwork, and enlarges series logos on the main Sets page.
Shows authentic expansion symbols for pre-Scarlet & Violet sets, includes announced upcoming sets, improves special-collection artwork fallbacks, and adds IPA distribution.
